description: HKD interbank offered rates (HIBOR) by tenor: overnight, 1-week, 1/3/6/9/12-month, one record per day (end_of_day). Source is the Monthly Statistical Bulletin er-ir series. Use from/to to window the dates.

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of columns to return, e.g. "end_of_date,hibor_overnight".

from.description: Start of date window, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM for monthly series), e.g. "2026-01-01".

lang.description: Language of text fields: "en" (default), "tc", or "sc". Required by some datasets (e.g. coin-cart-schedule).

pagesize.description: Records per page (default ~100). Max varies by dataset.

to.description: End of date window, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM for monthly series), e.g. "2026-01-31".

name: hkma_interbank_interest_rates
title: Hkma Interbank Interest Rates
